name: Pigeon Point Light Station SHP
description: Pigeon Point Light Station State Historic Park sits on a cliff about 50 miles south of San Francisco. Its 115-foot lighthouse, one of the tallest on the West Coast, has guided mariners since 1872.
fullDescription: Pigeon Point Light Station State Historic Park sits on a cliff about 50 miles south of San Francisco. Its 115-foot lighthouse, one of the tallest on the West Coast, has guided mariners since 1872.
whatTheyOffer:
- Grounds with lighthouse views, picnic areas, and whale and seal watching
- The original 1872 Fresnel lens on display in the fog signal building
- Visitor center and park store (Thursday through Tuesday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., as staffing permits)
- Overnight lodging at HI Pigeon Point Lighthouse Hostel (fees apply); no camping
howToGetIt: Admission and parking are free. The day-use area is open 8 a.m. to sunset. The lighthouse tower is closed for restoration but can be viewed from the grounds. For hostel reservations, call 650-879-0633.
keywords: Pigeon Point, lighthouse, state historic park, Pescadero, San Mateo County, hostel, coastal, tallest lighthouse
